children: Citi on Thursday said it raised its mark-to-market Brent average forecast for the third quarter of 2026 to $86 a barrel from $80 a barrel previously, as the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz has taken longer than its prior assumption.
Citi said it is maintaining its fourth quarter 2026 and 2027 Brent average forecasts at $70 per barrel and $65 per barrel respectively.
